name: Pervasive Commodities Limited
summary: Pervasive Commodities Limited engages in trading of agricultural commodities in India. It offers soft agricultural commodities, such as wheat, pulses, spices, grains, coffee, cocoa, and sugar; and hard commodities, including gold and oil. The company also offers metals and energy commodities. The company was formerly known as Starvox Electronic Limited and changed its name to Pervasive Commodities Limited in January 2016. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
